title: Umthwalo Owaletha Ukuphulukiswa
intro: Umphefumulo ovivinywe kakhulu waphucwa induduzo, abangane, kanye namandla omzimba. Ehlukanisiwe nokuhlupheka okujulile, le nceku ka-Allah yaphendukela kuphela kuNkulunkulu. Ngokubekezela okungaguquki nomthandazo osuka enhliziyweni, kwafika igagasi lesihe eladlula konke okwakulindelwe. Ubani lo muntu ozinikele kuye wavula umnyango wokubuyiselwa?
clues: Ngangiyinceku ethandekayo ka-Allah, ngijabulela inala, umndeni ochumayo, kanye nempilo enhle ezinsukwini zami.
Kwabe sekwehla isilingo: ingcebo yahamba, abathandekayo bahamba, futhi inyama yami yahlaselwa ukuhlupheka okukhulu.
Labo abaseduze kwami ​​​​abakwazanga ukubekezelela isimo sami, futhi ngashiywa ngedwa, umzimba wami ugcwele ukuhlupheka.
Ngabiza iNkosi yami, ngamemezela ukuthi uSathane ungithinte ngokukhathala nesijeziso.
Impendulo yafika — umyalo wokuba ngishaye phansi ngonyawo lwami, futhi kulo kwaphuma amanzi abandayo ukuze ngiphulukiswe.
INkosi yami yasusa ubunzima ngokuphelele futhi yangibuyisela umndeni wami, wanda, njengophawu lwesihe kulabo abacabangayo.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Waphuma esiswini senhlanzi enkulu waya endaweni ephephile

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
